name: secret-key
effect: Used by trainer in the Galactic Eterna Building, on the ground floor, to the left of the TV : Unlocks the secret Rotom room, in which there are five appliances which can change Rotom’s form.
shortEffect: Gen IV: The key to Rotom’s appliance room. Gen III: The key to Cinnabar Gym.

flavorTextEntries.text: The key to the CINNABAR ISLAND GYM’s entrance.
The key to CINNABAR ISLAND GYM’s front door. It is colored red and decorated.
A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.
